UNION ALL
SELECT 'constraints', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid))), '[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.__rag_change_events'::regclass
UNION ALL
SELECT 'states', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT rce_status,rce_merge_mode,count(*) AS count,max(rce_created_at) AS latest FROM public.__rag_change_events GROUP BY rce_status,rce_merge_mode) s;
